support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs that the registry link be treated as unresolved.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; the packet provides name overlap between billing (Northbridge Analytics Inc.) and registry row 2019-0008841 (NORTHBRIDGE ANALYTICS LLC) but explicitly records that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and directs treating the registry link as unresolved, so neither positive nor negative identity burden is met.
